NONE: › said when you believe that something that has just happened or been said proves that you are right or telling the truth
（用於表示相信剛發生的事情或表明你說的是真話）還用我多說嗎？
› specialized also my/the case rests law said by lawyers in a law court when they have finished the explanation of their case

example: When told of Smith's angry response to her claim, she said simply, "I rest my case." (= his response proves that what I say is true)
當被告知史密斯對她的說法的惱怒反應時，她只是說：「還用我多說嗎？」
